name: AWS Lake Formation
overview: AWS Lake Formation helps build/govern data lakes on S3 and centrally manage fine-grained data access permissions integrated with the Glue Data Catalog.
examSignals: Centralized fine-grained permissions for S3 data lake tables/columns: Lake Formation
Object-level access policy only: S3 IAM/bucket policies

compareWith.diff: Lake Formation governs data lake access and administration; Glue catalogs metadata and runs data integration/ETL jobs.
